fields.title: Source column
fields.description: Select the column containing the paths to the files/folders that must be copied/moved.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Fail if source does not exist
fields.description: If the source file/folder to copy/move does not exit the node will fail.

fields.title: Delete source files / folders
fields.description:
Delete all files/folders that have been successfully copied from the source folder. The
output contains an additional column indicating if the file has been deleted (true) or
not (false).

fields.title: Fail on unsuccessful deletion
fields.description:
If the 'Delete source files / folders' option is activated and something goes wrong during the
deletion process the node will fail.

fields.title: Choose destination
fields.description: Select a method with which to set the destination.

fields.title: Destination column
fields.description:
Select the column containing the destination, i.e., the new location and names of the files/folders to be copied/moved.
Note: If the source references a file/folder the destination also has to be a file/folder.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Create missing folders
fields.description: If enabled, missing folders in the specified path will be created automatically.

fields.title: Overwrite policy
fields.description: How to handle files to be copied already existing in destination folder

fields.title: Destination file path
fields.description:
Depending on the selected mode the location of the files/folders to be copied to the destination
folder will differ.

fields.title: Folder prefix
fields.description: The folder prefix (the beginning of the path) to be ignored when using 'Path after prefix' mode.

fields.title: Detailed output
fields.description:
If selected the output will not only show the folder that has been copied/moved but also all the
files/folders it contains.
